name: serpmonn-android
description: Serpmonn Capacitor shell for RuStore / Google Play (opens /frontend/app/)

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
